text:
Hello everyone!
I am a Spanish citizen with a B1 foreign expert visa, living in Israel for almost 3 years already. I am preparing for the submission of a B1 partner visa and collecting documentation, and I have a couple questions:
* I extractקג most documents from the Spanish online portal, that retrieved my birth certificate and even apostilled it online... Is this digital apostille OK? Does anyone know?
* They also provide the option to get the documents in a "multilingual version" with an annex translating the document in English, also digitally authenticated by the Ministry. Is that enough, or do they require a translation done in Israel anyway? 
* As for the criminal records - Spain can digitally emit a document confirming that I am "clean" in all EU countries. I would need to translate this, I guess, but besides that... is this enough? I lived in several EU countries and getting their original criminal records is, sometimes, almost impossible (try to get a German one from outside of Germany...). Any experiences?
* Finally: the singlehood certificate (certificado de fe de estado civil) does require an in-person trip. The Spanish embassy in Tel Aviv can provide it - but, as any consular document, it cannot be apostilled. Is this enough for our friends at Misrad HaPnim, or do they want us to fly back to Spain and get the apostille?

I will be grateful for any help...! Thank you in advance!
